\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{pmmeta}
\pmcanonicalname{RingedSpace}
\pmtitle{Ringed space}
\pmclassification{msc}{14A15}
\endmetadata
\begin{document}
\begin{definition}
A ringed space is a pair $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ where $X$ is a topological space and $\mathcal{O}_X$ is a sheaf of rings on $X$.
\end{definition}
\end{document}
